description:
PLEASE READ CAREFULLY.
Office Location: Helios Building, Quang Trung Software Center, District 12
Working time: Mon – Fri. Work in shift: Dayshift (9:00 – 18:00) and Split shift (8:00 – 12:00 (onsite) then 20:00 – 00:00 (wfh) – with extra income for night time)
As a Connection Support I(Connection Setup Specialist), you will:
KRA 1: Establish New Trading Partners (35%)
* Ensure the Trading Partner has a single EDI point of contact for all inquiries
* Establish and test connectivity between the Trading Partners and Customers
* Gather, maintain, and publish mapping specifications for departmental consumption
* Ensure mapping is being completed in accordance with the departmental Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
KRA 2: Relationship Management (35%)
* Establish and maintain accurate Trading Partner test instructions
* Align TrueCommerce with the Trading Partners as a preferred EDI provider for their vendors
KRA 3: Technology Management (30%)
* Establish oneself as a subject matter expert status by mastering all variations of connectivity (FTP, AS2, VAN)
* Oversee AS2 certificate lifecycle through the designated management platform, ensuring proactive monitoring of expirations and timely coordination with partners for certificate renewals
* Troubleshoot and resolve all production communication errors in accordance with departmental SLAs
* Contribute to standard operating procedures (SOPs)
* Recognize extraneous connectivity hops and coordinate to simplify and reduce cost
requirements_text:
* Good English; able to communicate via telephone, and well-written email.
* Experience with FTP and AS2 or knowledge in network protocol types is a plus
* Experience in client services, business to business, computer support/service, experience preferred
* Having a bachelor’s degree in IT-related majors . Degrees in other disciplines will be considered
* Able to work solo or as part of a team
* Must be able to manage time efficiently, prioritize tasks, and work well in a team setting, to reach team and department goals
